title: PostgreSQL Advisory Locks for Concurrency Control (No Redis in Phase 1)
context: Need to prevent concurrent duplicate sync runs without introducing external cache/queue infrastructure.
decision: Use PostgreSQL advisory locks (pg_try_advisory_lock) for scheduler idempotency and job locking. No Redis in Phase 1.
consequences: Eliminates the operational complexity of maintaining a Redis cluster in Phase 1
PostgreSQL native advisory lock provides atomic, crash-safe synchronization across sync runs
risks: Lock session must be cleanly released on process termination or unhandled crash.
